Adventures of Tom Sawyer.name: Adventures of Tom Sawyer
Adventures of Tom Sawyer.summary:
Adventures of Tom Sawyer is a platformer game released for the Nintendo Entertainment System in 1989. The storyline does not directly portray the book written by Mark Twain. However, the characters in the game are the same as in the book.

Control in this typical platform game consists of jumping and throwing rocks. Players must avoid many obstacles, such as rolling barrels, and defeat persistent enemies, such as pirates, mice, and even a giant octopus.

The level order has been changed in the English version (perhaps to avoid confusing players by starting with the rafting stage). The Japanese original's level 5, the pirate ship, is the English version's level 1, making the beginning of the game much more difficult and the plot non-cohesive.

Kid Kool and the Quest for the Seven Won.name: Kid Kool and the Quest for the Seven Wonder Herbs
Kid Kool and the Quest for the Seven Won.summary: Kid Kool and the Quest for the Seven Wonder Herbs is a 2D Platformer game, developed and published by Vic Tokai, which was released in 1988.

Ultima - Exodus.name: Ultima: Exodus
Ultima - Exodus.summary:
Ultima: Exodus is the first release for the Nintendo Entertainment System of the popular series. Don't expect to able to follow the storylines from the original computer series; this version is completely different and is meant as a stand alone game. At the beginning of the game, you can form your party either from a computer generated randomization or make your own characters if you have the time and talent to do so (there are a TON of different options for characters).

The evil Exodus has risen from the seas to make his new home on a fiery island near Britannia Kingdom. Lord British sends out a plea for the best and greatest warriors known to man to join your group as you set out to defeat this monster. So gather ye weapons and magic spells and take on evils unknown is Ultima: Exodus.
